decision: Challenge schemas retain only exact authored ContentReference and RuleReference pairs. Modes share one contract, including Survival. Objective, escape, and consequence values carry no local predicates, timers, mechanics, or rewards.
source_admission: The owner checks each reference against the current checkpoint, mode, and purpose after explicit bounds, basis/pin checks, participant admission, and exact ReferenceInventory membership. Denied, unavailable, or unsupported sources return a typed ChallengeSourceGap refusal. A successful plan therefore always has an empty source_gaps list; no partial plan can contain an unadmitted reference.
participant_admission: EncounterSourceOwner extends the existing ParticipantOwner for EntityId and Basis, and proposal and validation call validate_participants so actor identity/status checks are shared.
bounds: Caller budgets bound participant/objective/escape/consequence counts, pairwise participant checks, inventory scans, source-admission calls, and input/output bytes before callbacks or owned plan copies. Output bytes include a conservative upper bound for the fixed checkpoint-pin labels.
lifecycle: EncounterDirector only produces and revalidates an owned staged candidate. It has no commit, time, causal transition, rule execution, or mutation behavior. Existing objective transition APIs remain independent and unchanged.
